attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file TN franchise and excise tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Tennessee Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in TN (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "TN" streq and

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets TN economic nexus threshold ($100K or 200 transactions)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.state_code get "TN" streq and

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - filing required for both taxes
action_details.action_postfix: "TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to physical presence in Tennessee. Both taxes apply: 1. Franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth (greater of book value or property) 2. Excise tax: 6.5% on net earnings (apportioned income). Reference: TN Code § 67-4-2007 (Excise tax), TN Code § 67-4-2104 (Franchise tax), Form FAE 170 (Franchise and Excise Tax Return), TN Revenue Ruling 07-24 (Physical presence nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_postfix: "TN franchise and excise tax filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions in TN. Economic nexus applies to both franchise and excise taxes. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), TN Code § 67-4-2007(b) (Economic nexus), TN Notice 20-11 (Marketplace Facilitator Act and Economic Nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.tn_franchise_tax xdef 0.0 /result.tn_excise_tax xdef 0.0 /result.tn_total_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TN nexus - no filing requirement for franchise or excise tax. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate TN state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Tennessee Income Adjustments Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate TN state additions and subtractions
No nexus - no TN state adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"No nexus - no TN state adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate TN franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth. Net worth is the greater of book value or property value in TN.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Tennessee Franchise Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe franchise tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive net worth in TN

action_details.action_comment: Calculate franchise tax: 0.25% on net worth
action_details.action_postfix: result.tn_net_worth get result.tn_franchise_tax_rate get mul /result.tn_franchise_tax xdef "TN franchise tax calculation: Net worth × 0.25%. Combined minimum tax (franchise + excise): $100. Reference: TN Code 67-4-2104" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No net worth - franchise tax is zero
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.tn_franchise_tax xdef
"No net worth in TN - no franchise tax liability. Excise tax may still apply if there is net earnings." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No TN nexus - no franchise tax liability
action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /result.tn_franchise_tax xdef
"No TN nexus - no franchise tax liability." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate TN excise tax: 6.5% on apportioned net earnings. Combines with franchise tax for total TN tax liability.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Tennessee Excise Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe excise tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate excise tax: 6.5% on apportioned income
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.state_tax_rate get mul /result.tn_excise_tax xdef result.tn_excise_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /result.tn_excise_tax xdef result.tn_franchise_tax get result.tn_excise_tax get add /result.tn_total_tax xdef result.tn_minimum_tax get result.tn_total_tax get max /result.tn_total_tax xdef result.tn_total_tax get /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "TN franchise and excise tax calculated. Excise: 6.5% on net earnings. Franchise: 0.25% on net worth. Minimum $100. Reference: TN Code 67-4-2007, 67-4-2104" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No net earnings - excise tax is zero
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.tn_excise_tax xdef result.tn_franchise_tax get /result.tn_total_tax xdef result.tn_franchise_tax get 0 gt { result.tn_minimum_tax get result.tn_total_tax get max /result.tn_total_tax xdef } if result.tn_total_tax get /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TN net earnings - no excise tax. Franchise tax still applies if there is net worth. Minimum $100 if franchise tax owed." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no excise tax or franchise tax liability
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.tn_excise_tax xdef 0.0 /result.tn_total_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TN nexus - no excise tax or franchise tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto
